objective_success_bonus.condition: Both legs contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1) and |x|<0.15 and |y|<0.15 and |vy|<0.5

distance_improvement_bonus.payment_mode: per-step delta-based, diminishes as approach completes

controlled_descent_bonus.condition: first time entering near-pad region (distance<0.3) with m_power>0 and |angle|<0.2

touchdown_stability_bonus.condition: first time both legs contact near pad (distance<0.3) with |vy|<0.5, |vx|<0.5, |angle|<0.2
